findings.text: the object branch still stringifies an explicit null label while the mapping branch falls back to the value, so {"value": "x", "label": null} stores the option labelled with the literal "None" while {"x": null} stores it labelled with its own value; the node touched this exact branch and covered the null label only on the mapping side, and the defect is the same one the earlier repair names in its own docstring, read at f16342a4 and at head as (['x'], {'x': 'None'}).

the evidence_inputs sentence "re-measured before repair, _decision_options_as_choices({None: \"unix socket\"}) returned (['None'], {'None': 'unix socket'})" is true only of a tree with the mapping refusal removed: at the reviewed base f16342a4 that call raises OpError "decision option None carries a null 'value'", measured with the module path printed, so a reader taking the sentence as the base state would mis-place the gap in the guard rather than in the coverage.
